body: When the film belongs to the framework, every new stack means rewriting the story — same idea, new code each time.

sections.title: Your framework picks your film

body: Svelte, React and Vue wrappers speak the same film, and web components carry it everywhere else — same film, same chrome.

takeaway: Write the story once, play it anywhere.
